verdict.rationale: OpenCode can plug in external tools through local and remote MCP servers. It also supports custom agents, repo- or home-level skills and a JS/TS SDK for building integrations. That gives a route to bring third-party capabilities into workflows, but the evidence shows no partner agent-app ecosystem, marketplace or packaged third-party agent integration. Missing for 10: partner/third-party agent app marketplace or directory, documented installation of partner-built agents, evidence of vetted partner integrations, independent corroboration of third-party agent integration.
